title: Attn kernel mosaic strategist and prefill safety matrix
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Problem statement: We need a safer, fine-grained strategy for choosing attention kernels across heterogeneous request shapes and mixed model variants (v2/v3/quantized). Current coarse-grain selectors cause oscillation and occasional decode latency regressions during prefill bursts. This ticket proposes a 'mosaic strategist' that composes per-layer/per-shape kernel assignments together with a prefill safety matrix to gate aggressive choices during startup and burst windows.
acceptance_criteria: Reduction of 95th-percentile prefill latency regressions by >= 30% on QA workload compared to baseline (current selector).
No customer-facing error or OOM after rollout on canary fleet for 48h under synthetic burst traffic.
Automated telemetry detectors raise clear signal for kernel oscillation; alerts integrated into Console SLO dashboards.
Canary rollout playbook and automated rollback hooks implemented in runtime orchestration.
PR with implementation merged and e2e perf regression tests added to CI pipeline.
implementation_notes: Introduce a lightweight per-model 'mosaic spec' containing: layer predicates (shape ranges / head counts), allowed kernel family list ordered by preference, safety weight (0.0-1.0), and warmup budget windows.
At request admission, compute an aggregated kernel plan by combining model-level mosaic spec with runtime signals (GPU occupancy, KV cache hit rate, recent kernel-flip counts).
During prefill, consult prefill safety matrix: if warmup budget insufficient or flip-rate above threshold, restrict to conservative kernels (FlashAttn v2 stable or legacy v2-compat paths).
Add per-GPU short-term flip counter with exponential decay and a split-learner to avoid synchronized flips across workers.
Expose flags for canary: mosaic_enabled, safety_matrix_thresholds, flip_decay_ms via runtime config (config-service and env override for dedicated/private).
experiment_plan: Phase 1 (local/bench): unit tests for mosaic spec merging logic; microbench v2/v3 per-shape comparisons; synthetic prefill burst harness to validate flip counters.
Phase 2 (staging): deploy mosaic strategist to 10% of staging runtime nodes; run replayed production traces for 24h; collect perf, OOM, and flip-rate telemetry.
Phase 3 (canary): enable on 3% of canary fleet; run 48h with production traffic and synthetic bursts; evaluate regressions and guardrail alerts.
Phase 4 (gradual rollout): ramp by doubling canary percentage each 24h while monitoring SLOs and Telemetry detectors; hold/reroll on alert triggers.
rollback_plan: Immediate automatic rollback if: prefill-95p latency increases > 20% over baseline for 30m, OOM spike > 3x, or kernel flip rate > configured hard threshold.
Manual rollback playbook: if automatic rollback fails, ops run 'runtime/force-kernel-policy conservative' across affected pools and open incident with runtime team.
All rollbacks must attach diag bundle and timeline to the Linear ticket.
